parameters.content:
## FLOOWBOX - Multi-Agent Debate System
Day 30 — the most research-relevant workflow in the series.

Architecture:
- Agent A (Proposer): argues FOR
- Agent B (Opposer): argues AGAINST
- Round 1: Opening arguments (parallel)
- Round 2: Rebuttals (each agent sees other's opening)
- Judge Agent: impartial verdict + synthesis

Built to demonstrate: multi-agent orchestration, turn-taking, 
role specialization — all core AI research topics.
